data.name: Ramesh
data.gender_notes: Ramesh is used as a male name in hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Sanskrit rāma, 'Rama', + īśa, 'lord' — 'lord of Rama'. Its root is Sanskrit rāma + īśa. A classical Sanskrit name. Ramesh is a Sanskrit name meaning “Lord of Rama; (also) preserver”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Ramesh expresses “Lord of Rama; (also) preserver”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: From the Sanskrit rāma, 'Rama', + īśa, 'lord' — 'lord of Rama'.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ramesh total 28, reducing to 1. Number 1 is associated with leadership, independence and initiative.
